privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: Read how PrimeKortingscode handles your personal data, cookies and external links.

sections.heading: What data we process
sections.body: PrimeKortingscode processes as little data as possible. You can browse our pages without creating an account. We only process personal data such as your name and email address when you provide it yourself, for example through the contact form or the newsletter.

sections.heading: Cookies and analytics
sections.body: We use functional cookies to keep the site working and, with your consent, analytical cookies to understand which pages and offers are used most. You can change your preferences at any time through your browser settings.

sections.heading: External links and stores
sections.body: Coupon codes and deals link through to the store's website. Once you click such a link, the privacy policy of that store applies. We have no control over how external parties handle your data; review their policy before sharing any information.

sections.heading: Newsletter
sections.body: If you subscribe to the newsletter, we use your email address only to send you the best coupon codes and deals. Every email includes a link to unsubscribe immediately, after which we remove your details from our list.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You have the right to ask which data we hold about you, to have it corrected or deleted. Contact us through the contact page to do so; we normally reply within one business day.
